_readme: How the ticket pipeline would build and verify G-Eskayo/nourished (lib/project_profile.py). dispatch is OFF and no machines are listed. Playbook ios-app (the product is an iOS app; this repo holds its Fastify API and Next.js portal, the Swift app is not in it yet). Known gap: no tests yet (apps/api has vitest wired but no test files), so the only check is type-check. Check it with: ~/.agents/venv/bin/python ~/.agents/lib/project_profile.py selftest G-Eskayo/nourished

executor.notes: This is Nourished, a dish-discovery app: a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with apps/api (Fastify v5, TypeScript), apps/portal (Next.js restaurant portal) and packages/database (Prisma, PostgreSQL + PostGIS). The architecture is in docs/Nourished_Backend_Architecture.md. There are no tests yet, so write tests first (vitest in apps/api) for anything you change, and say plainly which behavior is untested. Verify with: corepack pnpm db:generate, then corepack pnpm type-check (turbo's type-check does not generate the Prisma client by itself: its dependsOn names a db:generate task the database package doesn't have). Never commit secrets or a real .env (only .env.example).

verify.label: Prisma client + type-check every package (turbo)
command: B=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pnpm-shim.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$B"' EXIT; corepack enable --install-directory "$B" pnpm && export PATH="$B:$PATH" && pnpm db:generate && pnpm type-check

dev.na: no dev-environment capture for the portal or the API yet
